# ActiveHome

> ActiveHome is a global AI-powered super app for everything related to homes and buildings — buy, rent, build, furnish and book across one ecosystem.

ActiveHome combines a property marketplace, hotel and hostel bookings, construction services, materials and furniture shops, interior and landscape design, and an AI valuation assistant for a worldwide audience.

## Pages
